+"""
+Minimal reproduction script for:
+"Nominal scale should be drawn the same way as categorical scales"
+
+NOTE: pandas 2.0 removed the ``mode.use_inf_as_null`` option, which
+seaborn/_core/plot.py still uses. That is an *environment compatibility*
+problem, unrelated to the issue under investigation, so this script
+registers a no-op shim for that option locally (source is NOT modified).
+"""
+
+import traceback
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+# --- environment shim (pandas>=2.0 removed mode.use_inf_as_null) ------------
+try:
+    pd.get_option("mode.use_inf_as_null")
+except Exception:
+    pd._config.config.register_option("mode.use_inf_as_null", False)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use("Agg")
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import seaborn.objects as so
+
+
+def inspect(label, pfunc):
+    print("=" * 70)
+    print(label)
+    try:
+        p = pfunc()
+        fig = p.plot()
+        ax = fig.axes[0]
+        print(f"  xlim            = {ax.get_xlim()}")
+        print(f"  ylim            = {ax.get_ylim()}")
+        print(f"  xaxis inverted  = {ax.xaxis_inverted()}")
+        print(f"  yaxis inverted  = {ax.yaxis_inverted()}")
+        print(f"  x grid visible  = {ax.xaxis.get_gridlines()[0].get_visible()}")
+        print(f"  y grid visible  = {ax.yaxis.get_gridlines()[0].get_visible()}")
+        plt.close(fig)
+    except Exception:
+        print("  EXCEPTION:")
+        traceback.print_exc()
+    print()
+
+
+inspect(
+    "x axis Nominal (categorical x, numeric y)",
+    lambda: so.Plot(x=["a", "b", "c"], y=[1, 2, 3]).add(so.Dot()),
+)
+
+inspect(
+    "y axis Nominal (numeric x, categorical y)",
+    lambda: so.Plot(x=[1, 2, 3], y=["a", "b", "c"]).add(so.Dot()),
+)
+
+inspect(
+    "x axis Nominal, explicit limit()",
+    lambda: so.Plot(x=["a", "b", "c"], y=[1, 2, 3]).add(so.Dot()).limit(x=("a", "c")),
+)
